name: menu
description: Menu — the way in (ES modules). The tree of what this node can make: a row per service, its advert beside it on hover or ↑↓, and its inputs page on click. The inputs page builds a form from the fields the catalog declares and books a job on the Scheduler. Holds no state, runs nothing, copies no description: the words stay in the service files.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run selftest
